headline: Fisherman's Row Ignites Afresh as Weathered Expanse Clashes Intensify
war_summary: Western waters have abruptly flared back to life over the past three hours, shattering the brief lull in Fisherman's Row with four rapid base upheavals that leveled two strategic positions into no-man's-land and left Colonials clinging to seven. Along the frozen spine of the Weathered Expanse, intense combat resumed around Frostmarch and Crow's Nest, producing three fresh base exchanges inside two hours as casualty rates accelerated sharply on a narrow 5–4 Colonial ledger. Hostilities likewise persisted along the Stlican Shelf, where two further base transactions logged up to the hour mark maintained a 7–2 Warden ascendancy. Conversely, the fierce island struggle across Godcrofts has fallen quiet following Colonial consolidation of all nine posts, while Stonecradle's line stabilized into a 5–4 Warden margin after early morning maneuvers. Attrition remains punishing in Callahan's Passage and Mooring County, where combined casualties exceeded seventeen hundred across two hours, while Dead Lands witnessed a steep climb in frontline losses despite an unbroken Colonial perimeter.
